div.div: From every state but OFF: CTRL.EN = 0 → OFF; a disconnect → DETACHED (not seen while RESET drives the bus). CMD.RESTART in RECOVERY, ENUM, RUN, BACKOFF, FAILED or UNSUPPORTED → RESET with ATTEMPT cleared. FAILED, UNSUPPORTED and FS_DETECTED wait for a disconnect with the lines released.
